profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a full-stack software engineer building applications across a variety of fields, ranging across:
- Physics-based predictions of color appearance under different lighting conditions
- Supply chain data monitoring with an automated pipeline for importing vendor data
- A parsing library for a proprietary seismic data standard
- A low-maintenance, NLP-driven second brain system with intelligent reminders
- Custom scheduling software which helped me orchestrate logistics for the Berkeley Model United Nations conference

I have taken ownership over the design, architecture, implementation, and deployment for all of the projects I have worked on. In doing so, I've greatly enjoyed getting to learn so much about such a wide array of subjects. I am particularly keen on spending more time learning about server infrastructure and networking, and I'm hoping I'll soon have a chance to dive deeper into database internals and operating systems as I build more experience working with systems languages.

I love solving difficult problems, taking on new challenges, and learning as much as I can about the world around me. This field has given me so many opportunities to pursue each of these things, and I am beyond excited to see what the future brings.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Maintain a full-stack inventory supply chain analytics platform, complete with a robust, automated data ingestion pipeline
- Manage deployment infrastructure for each of our apps, including CI/CD pipelines with comprehensive testing, monitoring, and alerting
- Design and administer optimized MySQL and PostgreSQL databases for each of our applications
- Collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders to gather requirements, demo solutions, and iteratively refine features
- Utilize agentic coding tools to streamline implementation of features, using disciplined context management and prompting best practices to maintain control over the quality of outputs

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Implemented a high-performance Java (Spring Boot) file parser for non-standard seismic data formats containing millions of data points, with 100% JUnit test coverage to ensure reliability and correctness.
- Created an interactive React dashboard to visualize site-level seismic data, including animated floor-by-floor motion during earthquake events to support intuitive structural analysis.
- Leveraged LangChain to construct a retrieval-augmented generation system with a fine-tuned LLM, automating hospital seismic compliance review summaries and reducing manual review effort from 30 hours to just 30 minutes.
- Trained and evaluated a regression model to prioritize facilities requiring departmental assistance, cutting projected costs by 43% while accelerating site development timelines by 36%.

positions.title: Vice President of Logistics
positions.description:
- Oversaw end-to-end planning and scheduling for an annual Model United Nations conference serving 1,500+ participants, ensuring smooth execution across multiple days and venues.
- Delivered a full-stack scheduling system using React and TypeScript with a Java (Spring Boot) and MongoDB backend to manage daily assignments for 100 staff members, automating calendar synchronization and cutting manual coordination effort from 8 hours to only 10 minutes.
- Coordinated logistics with 10 campus departments to allocate space for 20+ committees ranging from 15 to 300 attendees, optimizing room assignments to streamline operations and reduce projected costs by $10K.

positions.title: Vice Chair of Fifth Administrative and Budgetary Committee
positions.description: Cooperated with team to lead a committee of over 100+ high school students on the topic of budgetary management and allocation of assets, moderating discussion and providing feedback as well as creating topical preparatory newsletters for delegates.

positions.title: Research Staff Member
positions.description: Conducted and presented research on a wide array of international issues in order to educate and prepare high school students to discuss them during our conference.

• Assembled and analyzed daily sales and revenue data reports in order to track business performance and account for store inventory

projects.title: Spam Detection System for Emails
projects.description:
• Utilized SciKit-Learn to train a logistic regression model using binary classification on a dataset of 8,000+ entries to distinguish between spam and legitimate emails, allowing prediction of spam in the testing set with an accuracy of 85%
• Strengthened model performance through the use of cross-validation and regularization, carefully tuning hyper-parameters to increase accuracy by over 10% relative to the next-best model
• Employed natural language processing (NLP) techniques to manipulate data, including lowercasing, removing HTML tags, and executing regex functions with Pandas to extract features for use in training the prediction algorithm

projects.title: Predicting Housing Prices in Cook County
projects.description:
• Developed a robust linear regression model using SciKit-Learn for predicting housing prices in a dataset of 200,000+ entries and 60+ features, minimizing the test RMSE by achieving a 52% reduction in error relative to earlier models
• Designed a data processing pipeline using Python, splitting data into training and validation sets and performing feature engineering to enhance model performance while avoiding overfitting
• Conducted exploratory data analysis using Pandas, cleaning data with NumPy and regex functions on top of generating visualizations using Matplotlib to identify trends to leverage during algorithm development
